name: easy-notifyyy
displayName: Easy Notifyyy - AI Task Email Notifier
description: Get notified via email when Antigravity, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Kiro, or terminal tasks finish so you can walk away from your desk.

commands.title: Easy Notifyyy: Switch Notification Mode (Away / Always / Muted)
Easy Notifyyy: Configure Email Credentials (API Key / SMTP Password)
Easy Notifyyy: Send Test Notification Email
Easy Notifyyy: Setup Agent Hooks & MCP (Antigravity, Claude, Kiro, Copilot)

enumDescriptions: Only send email when the IDE is unfocused or idle for longer than idleSeconds.
Always send email when an AI or long-running task finishes.
easyNotifyyy.mode.markdownDescription:
When Easy Notifyyy should send email notifications.

[⚙️ Open Visual Settings Dashboard](command:easyNotifyyy.openSettings) · [📨 Send Test Notification Email](command:easyNotifyyy.sendTestEmail)

easyNotifyyy.idleSeconds.description: Seconds of inactivity in the IDE before considering the user away (when mode is 'away').

easyNotifyyy.cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between consecutive email notifications to prevent inbox spam.

easyNotifyyy.recipientEmail.markdownDescription:
Destination email address where AI task notifications are sent.

[📨 Send Test Notification Email](command:easyNotifyyy.sendTestEmail)

easyNotifyyy.senderEmail.description: From email address used when sending notifications.

easyNotifyyy.emailProvider.description: Email delivery provider: Resend API, custom SMTP (Gmail/Outlook/etc.), or custom HTTP webhook.

easyNotifyyy.resendApiKey.markdownDescription:
Resend API Key (starts with `re_...`). Alternatively, use the Visual Settings Dashboard to save it in OS Keychain.

[📨 Click here to Send Test Notification Email](command:easyNotifyyy.sendTestEmail)

easyNotifyyy.smtp.host.description: SMTP server hostname (used when emailProvider is 'smtp').

easyNotifyyy.smtp.port.description: SMTP server port (587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit TLS).

easyNotifyyy.smtp.secure.description: Use implicit TLS for SMTP (true for port 465; false for 587 STARTTLS).

easyNotifyyy.smtp.user.description: SMTP username / email address (used when emailProvider is 'smtp').

easyNotifyyy.smtp.password.markdownDescription:
SMTP password or Gmail App Password (for Gmail with 2FA, generate a 16-character App Password at myaccount.google.com/apppasswords).

[📨 Click here to Send Test Notification Email](command:easyNotifyyy.sendTestEmail)

easyNotifyyy.webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL to POST JSON notifications to (used when emailProvider is 'webhook').

easyNotifyyy.includeSummary.description: Include AI message summary in notification emails. Disable for sensitive codebases.

easyNotifyyy.serverPort.description: Localhost HTTP/MCP server port for agent hooks and MCP tool calls.

easyNotifyyy.minTerminalDurationSeconds.description: Minimum terminal command duration in seconds before triggering a completion notification.

easyNotifyyy.detectors.antigravity.description: Watch Antigravity transcript logs for turn completion or user input requests.

easyNotifyyy.detectors.copilot.description: Watch IDE chat session files (GitHub Copilot / Cursor) for completed responses.

easyNotifyyy.detectors.claudeAndKiro.description: Accept Stop and Notification hook payloads from Claude Code and Kiro on the local server.

easyNotifyyy.detectors.terminal.description: Notify when long-running terminal commands complete.
